{{Quote|We do have a lovely lady here tonight from Tahina who's got those big dark eyes you're looking for.|A hostess, to Cassian Andor|<ref name="Kassa">{{Andor|Kassa (episode)}}</ref>}}
'''Tahina''' was a location<ref name="Kassa" /> in the [[Chorlian sector]]'s [[Tahina system]], which was situated in the [[Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="Appendix" /> and the [[New Territories]].<ref name="NewTerritories" /> It was situated in grid square R-4 of the [[Standard Galactic Grid]].<ref name="Appendix" /> In [[5 BBY]], when the [[human]] [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]] visited a [[Leisure Zone brothel|brothel]] on<ref name="Kassa" /> the [[planet]]<ref name="Guide">''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]''</ref> [[Morlana One]] in an [[Search for Kerri|attempt]] to find [[Kerri|his sister]], he inquired about a [[Gender|girl]] [[Kenari (people)|from]] [[Kenari]], his [[homeworld]]. The [[Unidentified brothel hostess|hostess]] who was assisting him checked for an employee from Kenari, but discovered that the Kenari girl who had worked there was no longer present. They then told Andor of a different employee, a "lovely lady" from Tahina who had big, dark [[eye]]s.<ref name="Kassa" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tahina was mentioned in "[[Kassa (episode)|Kassa]],"<ref name="Kassa" /> the debut episode of the [[Andor Season 1|first season]] of the live-action [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', which was released on [[September 21]], [[2022]].<ref name="Release">{{Twitter|starwars|status/1557442379975573504|[[Star Wars]]|date=2022-8-10|quote=This is what revolution looks like. Watch #Andor, a Star Wars Original Series, streaming only on @DisneyPlus September 21.|archivedate=20220810191942}}</ref>
